relevant_changes.title: LIFE 2026 CET – Supporting the clean energy transition of European industry and businesses
relevant_changes.note: Relevant for energy efficiency/decarbonisation/digitalisation of industry. Recommended role for Meridionale Impianti: consortium partner rather than coordinator unless a strong EU consortium is already available.

relevant_changes.title: LIFE Calls for proposals 2026
